name: AZCubing Winter 2016

venue.name: [Mesa Convention Center](http://mesaaz.gov/business/mesa-convention-center)
venue.details: Competition will be held in Superstition Ballroom North in Building A.

information:
Registration Fee:
$12 base fee + $2 per event.
3x3 is included in the base fee.
There is a 65 competitor limit at this event and you must register online.
We will not accept registrations at the event.
$1 per competitor will go to the WCA.
